title: The Last Regiment
author: M. M. Blackwood
blurb: Zephyrine Hartwell, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
